ModMetaData.name: Flavor Text Extended
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
An add-on for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3245374432]Flavor Text[/url] (hekmo). Requires it, contains none of its files, and does nothing without it.
901 NEW DISHES
French and regional cooking first, then the wider repertoire: Italy, the Maghreb, Japan, Korea, Peru, India, China, the Levant, Mexico, West Africa, Eastern Europe, the Caribbean, Polynesia.
Each dish is defined by a combination of ingredients. That combination is what the engine draws on, not the name - so the same dish under five different names would add nothing, and is not here. Where two dishes share a combination it is deliberate: the engine picks at random among matching definitions, weighted by how narrow each one is, so sharing produces variety rather than conflict.
WHAT YOUR COLONY GROWS DECIDES WHAT YOU SEE
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3245374432]Flavor Text[/url] names a meal after what went into it, so a dish can only ever appear if its ingredients exist in your game. These 901 lean on a wider pantry than vanilla keeps - wheat, cheese, butter, cream, onion, tomato, garlic, chilli. On a vanilla-only save about forty of them can fire; farming and cooking mods can make more dishes available, depending on their ingredients and meal types.
That is how the engine works rather than a shortcoming: nothing is lost, a dish simply waits for its ingredient. But it is worth knowing before you install.
NEW INGREDIENT CATEGORIES
Leek and shallot get categories of their own, so a dish can ask for them by name; both still count as onion for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3245374432]Flavor Text[/url]'s own dishes. Five reptile and amphibian meat categories - turtle, alligator, iguana, lizard, frog - split out of the single herptile category.
THIRD-PARTY INGREDIENTS
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3245374432]Flavor Text[/url] matches keywords against both defNames and labels. This mod also attaches selected ingredients explicitly by defName, including ingredients whose names do not match the expected keywords: highland barley, hybrid rice, salted mustard greens, bok choy, ginkgo nuts, grain wines, dried meat and cheeses, among others.
None of those mods are required. Each provider-specific ingredient reference is guarded by its mod's package ID. No DLC is required. The [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2877536640]Chinese Traditional Cultural Things Expanded[/url] hooks are not certified for RimWorld 1.6.
FRENCH
This mod contains the English content. For French names, descriptions and ingredient grammar, install the separate [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3806100488]Flavor Text Extended - Français[/url] companion alongside [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3245374432]Flavor Text[/url] and this mod. The French companion is optional.
IF I GO QUIET
If I do not answer within a reasonable time after being contacted, anyone may freely update this or any other of my mods, including publishing a continuation of it. All credit must be preserved.
AI-GENERATED
The dishes, their descriptions and the ingredient patches were written with Claude (Anthropic) and ChatGPT (OpenAI), under my direction and review: I chose which dishes to write, which categories to split and which combinations to keep. The mod icon and the Preview illustration are generated with DALL-E (OpenAI).
THANKS
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3245374432]hekmo, for Flavor Text[/url]: how names are composed, how a definition is picked and how ingredients inflect are all his work, and this mod is only new content for it. daylight ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3614595617]RimLife Cultivation Plus[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2951594887]RimLife Expansion Trading items[/url]), Diamond.J, DaJian, Frolg and TangWan ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2877536640]Chinese Traditional Cultural Things Expanded[/url]) and VVenchov ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3448458106]VV - New Harvest[/url]), whose ingredients this mod recognises when they are installed. DRILLED_HEAD, for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3723096620][DHM]Korean cuisine[/url]: discovering its Altang, Beondegi, Bungeoppang, Jjapaghuri and Kimchijeon prompted five independently written dish definitions here. RimWorks, for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3791648678]Pickle[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3733484696]RimLogging[/url]: this release was tested headless, in a real running game, through their tools. Development-only, not a dependency of this mod. My own PickleTools, a shared testing toolkit across my mods, unpublished: the without-odyssey pass reads ModsConfig through its ExpansionSteps.
Credits, provenance and licence (MIT) are in ATTRIBUTION.md and LICENSE, shipped with the mod.
